tagline: Eastern Seaboard gateway — marina depth + island day-trip volume near Bangkok.
summary: Pattaya sits ~2hr by road SE of Bangkok on the Eastern Seaboard, with Southeast Asia's largest marina (Ocean Marina) and heavy day-trip flow to Koh Larn. It is the natural Gulf-gateway complement to Bangkok: a place to prove premium coastal and island-transfer corridors with strong existing marine infrastructure.

demand_signals.detail: Bali Hai Pier moves large daily volumes of day-trippers to nearby islands.
Ocean Marina Yacht Club anchors charter, berthing and premium marine demand.
Eastern Seaboard tourism and EEC business travel create premium transfer demand.

use_cases: Pattaya <-> Koh Larn premium island transfer
navier_fit: High. Best existing marine infrastructure of the new cluster (Ocean Marina); short island corridors; clear premium WTP. Strong pedestal/charging partner case at the marina.
competitive_landscape: Conventional speedboats and ferries to Koh Larn; no premium electric option. Ocean Marina serves charters but not scheduled transfer.
seasonality: Peak: Nov-Mar cool season. Gulf is relatively sheltered here vs open Gulf islands — broader operating window.
regulatory_note: Thai cabotage + Marine Department licensing; Chonburi/EEC special economic zone may offer a pilot-friendly regulatory environment.

precedents.label: Ocean Marina Yacht Club
precedents.note: Largest marina in SE Asia — natural charging/berth partner

grab.super_app_fit: Grab in-app island day-trip bundles (boat + GrabCar from Bangkok) and marina concierge transfers.
grab.wedge: Day-trip island bundles originating from Bangkok via Grab — pairs the Bangkok deal with a proven coastal corridor.

transit_planning.note: Marina infrastructure makes this the easiest charging-partner case.

_enrichment.note: Connected city brief hung off the Koh Samui / Gulf flagship. Geometry sealed via Grok from Bucket-C BP files.
